name: alertdialog
description: A modal dialog that interrupts with an urgent message needing a response, of which a destructive-action confirmation is the archetype. It is dialog-modal's specialisation and not a rival to it: every requirement below is that pattern's, with role="alertdialog" in place of role="dialog", because the role is what tells assistive technology to announce the dialog's contents on open rather than its name alone. It is a pattern of its own rather than a carve-out inside dialog-modal because an exception names one requirement and cannot say why a component is RIGHT to deviate: a component binding dialog-modal and excepting roles.element is a correct component filed as a defect, and the exception carries no reason a reader can act on. Bind dialog-modal for a dialog that merely takes the interaction; bind this one only when the message is urgent and the response is consequential.
